issues.reason: The overview explicitly says Width:9cm, and the user states the annotations are in centimetres. Reinspection of plant-1/Media (6).jpeg shows the blade spanning roughly one centimetre interval at the photographed ruler section, rather than nine labelled centimetre intervals. 0.9 cm is a proposed explanation only; exact correction and whether the photographed section represents maximum width remain unconfirmed.
issues.ruler_reading_basis: The ruler shows adjacent large labels 1, 2 and 3 for centimetres, each separated by ten smaller millimetre subdivisions. The visible blade above the ruler spans approximately one such major interval. This conflicts with a 9 cm width for that blade; it is not a reason to reinterpret all annotations as millimetres.

limitations: No machine-readable original specimen/leaf-to-frame correspondence is supplied. Stable annotation IDs in this transcription do not assert existing leaf folder indices except where explicitly documented.
User clarified whole height as stem base to the very tip, using two rulers. Height values remain in centimetres. Ruler joining/offset and uncertainty are not independently verified.
Leaf length may differ between straight base-to-tip, curved surface length and manually flattened geometry. Width convention is not documented.

Plant 1 upper-blade source width remains 9 cm, as annotated. User asserts centimetres. The ruler photograph appears inconsistent with that width; proposed 0.9 cm remains unconfirmed and this width is excluded from numerical accuracy use.
Plant 1 ear must be analysed separately from leaves. Plant 4 organ type requires review.
Photographs provide ruler evidence, but repeat measurements and a measurement-uncertainty protocol are absent.
Five specimens support descriptive validation of this batch, not an independent claim of generalisation across species or plants.
